limits: One run of each. The scenario is deterministic in geometry but Nav2's recovery count varies between runs; 15 was observed against a ceiling of 18 derived from the behaviour tree, which is not a wide margin.

blocked_road_world exists because slam_world cannot host this test: see docs/incidents.md on the costmap forgetting a blockage it cannot hold in view. The result therefore says nothing about blockages larger than the robot's sensor footprint.
2D chain only. The 3D chains have neither this scenario nor the dynamic obstacle one.
Gazebo exited with SIGSEGV during teardown after the verdict and entity cleanup; no scoped process remained. This known external teardown fault did not change the run verdict.

negative_control.note: The executable negative control moved the seal 1.5 m clear of the doorway, everything else unchanged. It printed VERDICT FAIL and ros2 launch returned non-zero. Without it a pass would not show that the criteria discriminate.

thresholds.maximum_recoveries_source: navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml: six outer RecoveryNode retries, each able to drive one planner retry, one controller retry and one RoundRobin recovery action
